verification_report.summary: The finite-divisor parameter-family proposition and the following local multiplier-ideal calculation are correct within the stated, accepted scope. The full real positive-cone preimage is open before restriction to the orthant, including zero coefficients and n=1. Mean-normalized smooth solution families patch and have compact-parameter C-infinity bounds. Poincare--Lelong, extended-measure locality, L1/capacity/smooth convergence, probability-normalized total variation, and the all-model finite-sum Lelong formula all apply as claimed. The local multiplier ideal is (z_1^{floor(a_j)}) and can jump at an integer without conflicting with the proved convergence.
